answer: Admission needs a slashable bond plus signed vouchers from a random committee of already-admitted agents; voting power grows as the square root of bonded stake per verified identity. Cloning a wallet buys nothing: doubling influence costs quadruple locked capital, and each committee seat can vouch for only a few newcomers, so a fake cluster needs honest endorsements it cannot forge. Caught fraud burns the bond and evicts the cluster. The pearl of reputation stays scarce, the oasis of payouts is guarded by real backers, and a hollow army of clones collapses under its own cost.
